title: Coder 2.6.0 before 2.29.21, 2.30.0 before 2.34.10, 2.35.0 before 2.35.8, 2.36.0 before 2.36.5, and 2.37.0 before…
description: Coder versions 2.6.0 before 2.29.21, 2.30.0 before 2.34.10, 2.35.0 before 2.35.8, 2.36.0 before 2.36.5, and 2.37.0 before 2.37.1 contain a denial of service vulnerability in the workspace agent dRPC API. The vulnerability arises because handlers dereference unset request sub-messages and unconfigured Tailnet providers without recovering from panics. An attacker with a workspace agent token can exploit this by sending specific malformed messages to repeatedly crash the coderd process.
